          name: (viewbox_attribute_name)
          value: (viewbox_attribute_value
            (viewbox_value
              (number)
              (comma_wsp)
              (number)
              (comma_wsp)
              (number)
              (comma_wsp)
              (number))))))
    (end_tag
      name: (name)))
  (text))
